no EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-koui) input processing system for Japanese medical clinics; handles outpatient medical procedure entry and fee calculation
purpose.summary: ORCGK02 is a large batch/interactive program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite. It handles medical procedure (shinryo-koui) input, validation, and fee calculation for outpatient visits. The program manages screen SPA data, parameter files, insurance combination checks, prescription flags, and various medical billing rules.

notable_features: 82 COPY statements referencing domain-specific copybooks (.INC files)
154 CALL statements indicating heavy subprogram delegation
Large working-storage with many flag fields (FLG-*) and index fields (IDX-*)
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for SPA and parameter data
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
File paths rooted at /var/tmp/ indicating Linux/Unix runtime
Extensive revision history in comments spanning 2000-2003
verdict.notes: Source is 624KB / 14674 lines, truncated in display to first 16000 chars. Comments contain Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP, decoded here as latin-1 producing mojibake. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. No COMP-3 is unusual for financial data but consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA codebase style.
